response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years experience requirement with over 15 years of full-stack work, including recent hands-on TypeScript/Node.js product development, React, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes, and notably direct AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling experience — a rare and explicitly required skill. A strong testing culture (TDD, test frameworks he authored, testing workshops) aligns well with the role's quality focus. Gaps are mostly around specific stack items (Nest.js, Vitest/Playwright, Kotlin) that a developer of this caliber should pick up quickly.
strengths: Direct AI agent development and MCP tooling experience, matching a hard-to-find requirement
Deep full-stack TypeScript/Node.js/React experience with cloud (AWS) and Kubernetes exposure
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, code reviews, testing tools authorship, and community teaching
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience listed despite it being in the primary stack
No demonstrated Kotlin, and Java experience appears dated (secondary stack gap)
No direct mention of Vitest/Jest/Playwright; testing expertise is largely in D-language and Selenium ecosystems
